headline: Just Eat has extended its delivery-robot trial with Starship Technologies to Cambourne in Cambridgeshire, where a Morrisons supermarket now sends grocery orders out by robot.
score_reason: Pool 4 lowered by 1: the expansion was first covered on 6-7 Oct 2026, before the window, so this is late coverage of a small trial.
importance_line: Robot grocery delivery is reaching one more UK town, which matters to Cambourne shoppers who can now get Morrisons orders from the Just Eat app only by robot, but it is a trial in four stores with no figures yet on how many orders, how fast or how customers feel.
summary: Retail Technology Innovation Hub reports, with quotes from Morrisons, Just Eat and Starship Technologies, that Just Eat is widening its trial of autonomous delivery robots made by Starship to Cambourne, the first trial town where Just Eat did not already offer grocery delivery, with the Cambourne Morrisons supermarket now live as the fourth Morrisons to use the robots after three Morrisons Daily stores in Sunderland and Milton Keynes. Morrisons says customers ordering from that store through the Just Eat app will have their orders delivered exclusively by robot, and the companies cite extra delivery capacity before the festive season; the expansion was first covered in the trade press on 6 and 7 Oct 2026, and no results from the trial have been published.
notes: Read in full via Retail Technology Innovation Hub (fulltext). The 6 Oct date comes from a Google News listing of The Grocer's headline (not read); other trade outlets are listed on 7 Oct. Late coverage; score lowered by 1.
